meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: Claude会把Flask、Django或FastAPI等Python代码部署到Azure App Service,自动创建或复用资源组、服务计划和Web应用,然后执行部署并给出访问URL。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等关键词,或要求把Python部署到App Service时触发。

say.text: 把我的Flask应用部署到Azure App Service
say.note: Claude会自动完成资源准备和代码部署。

say.text: 将当前Django项目部署到App Service
say.note: 会按Oryx自动检测配置启动命令。
会设置uvicorn启动命令并部署。

howto.what_en: Claude deploys Python code (Flask, Django, FastAPI) to Azure App Service, automatically creating or reusing the resource group, App Service plan, and web app, then runs the deployment and returns the site URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or ask to deploy Python to App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Claude will prepare resources and deploy the code automatically.

say_en.text: Deploy the current Django project to App Service
say_en.note: It will auto-detect startup command via Oryx and deploy.

say_en.text: Help me deploy FastAPI to Azure App Service
say_en.note: It will set the uvicorn startup command and deploy.
